CalcExpr.description:
Serializable calc expression leaf for a Derived view.

In ViewIR v0 only the `field_projection` form is admitted. `effectful_ts`
is decodable so the checker can reject it (IO belongs in an Effect
artifact); `raw_promise` is never admitted.

oneOf.description: Simple field projection: select a non-empty subset of named fields from the primary input.
Effectful TS leaf reference. Rejected inside a Derived view.

IrVersion01.description:
The only IR `0.1` version literal of the connector, widget, customization,
policy, derived, and setting roots and of ontology business packs.

TemporalScope.description: Optional time-dimension declaration for a Derived view.

TemporalScopeMode.description:
`mode: "current"` — resolve against latest committed facts (default).
`mode: "as_of_param"` — resolve against the fact log up to a caller-supplied timestamp.
  Views with this mode MUST list an input named "`as_of`" in their read-set.

ViewInputKind.description: Artifact kinds a derived view may read.

ViewInputRef.description:
Identifies a Source-bearing entity or relation, or another Derived view, that a
Derived view reads. References are exact-versioned to make the read-set computable.

alias.description: Alias used in the calc expression (e.g. "invoice", "`tax_rate`"); unique per view.

artifactId.description: Artifact id of the source entity, relation, or derived view being read.

version.description: Exact version of the referenced artifact.

ViewMaintenance.description:
Maintenance strategy. Only `recompute_on_read` is supported in v0.
`incremental` is reserved for a future IVM phase and MUST be rejected at extraction.

oneOf.description: Reserved — not implemented. The checker rejects artifacts carrying this value.
